violated_contract: A session-scoped mutation (conversation rotation, device re-pin, admission stop) that cannot proceed right now must defer or coalesce — it may not surface as an error that tears the live capture session down. When two rotation callers race on the session epoch the loser must see 'already handled', and a device reappearance must re-pin capture in place; both otherwise emit a Recording Stopped/Started pair and fragment one conversation into many.
canonical_prevention: Serialize session-scoped mutations behind a single in-flight guard whose contended result is a distinct non-error outcome (callers requeue their intent instead of stopping), route device re-pins through an in-place capture swap that preserves session and attempt identity, and bound every forced terminalization with an enum-backed finalization reason so the loop self-attributes in telemetry.
